author: fishingcake
title: Very useful but not everytime stable
content:
Generally a good app and very useful for sync&offline play without compromising audio quality. It often happens for me though that the app crashes regularly during an automatic offline folder sync with a dlna server.
Would also be great if the app could detect file duplicates and don’t show them on the album/artist page. I sync “Favorite Songs” and “Favorite Artist” from a dnla server, which often results in duplicates of the exact same audio file with the exact same name and content.
